Every day there is a fight for control of the {wiki:Poacher Caves}, in {wiki:Ferngrims Gate}, north of the Green Claw Swamp: on one side the wild animals, on the other the {creature:Poacher|Poachers} who hunt them — and, when the hunters overdo it, vengeful wolf spirits appear. Depending on who is in control, the caves have different creatures, and it is the players' actions that decide who wins.
